description.en:
She, the leader of the hidden sect, specializes in poison and assassination. A genius, and a weirdo, in the eyes of others. After dying from an accident, she was reborn in the body of a disfigured lady. Having her identity changed and unable to return to her family, she abandoned them, but, if she doesn't take revenge on those who caused her harm, will she be worthy of the title "The Ghostly Doctor"? As clouds gather, heroes fight to be the strongest! How will she conquer the world in a red robe, and fight among the strong heroes?!  
  
*The 2 missing chapters are announcements by the author.  


---
description.fr:
Feng Jiu, spécialisée dans le poison et l'assassinat, génie ou cinglée selon où l'on se place  
Morte des suites d'un accident, elle renaît dans le corps d'une femme défigurée.  
Feng Qing Ge, trahie par la servante qu'elle a recueillie enfant. Celle-ci lui vole son identité, la défigure et l'abandonne dans un bordel.  
Elle permet à Feng Jiu de renaître dans son corps, et avant de mourir lui demande de veiller sur ses parents et d'assouvir sa vengeance. Suivez les aventures de Feng Jiu, le docteur fantôme !
description.vi: Nàng, Ẩn môn chủ của thời hiện đại, tinh thông y độc, giỏi ám sát, trong mắt thế nhân là một cái thiên tài biến thái, một lần ngoài ý muốn bỏ mình, lại trọng sinh vào một cái thiếu nữ bị hủy dung! Thân phận bị hoán đổi? Không thể trở về gia tộc? Thân phận có thể không có! Nhà có thể không về! Nhưng lại hại người của nàng, tại sao lại không thể báo thù rửa hận ... thất vọng về Quỷ Y? Một khi phong vân quật khởi, quần hùng tranh bá! Lại nhìn xem nàng một thân hồng y mà ngao du thiên hạ, gương sáng xưng vương nơi trời cao!
description.pt-br: Ela, a líder da seita oculta, é especializada em veneno e assassinato. Uma gênia, e uma esquisita, aos olhos dos outros. Depois de morrer de um acidente, ela renasceu no corpo de uma senhora desfigurada. Tendo sua identidade mudada e incapaz de retornar à sua família, ela os abandonou, mas, se ela não se vingar daqueles que lhe causaram danos, será ela digna do título de "A Doutora Fantasma"? Enquanto as nuvens se juntam, os heróis lutam para ser os mais fortes! Como ela conquistará o mundo com um manto vermelho, e lutará entre os heróis mais fortes?!

description.en:
Joo In-gong was dragged into the remake of a game he was playing called <Knight Saga:Re>.

However, something wasn’t right. The only playable characters should be Loch of the human side and Zephyr of the demon side. Instead, he awakens in the body of Shutra— the ninth prince of the Demon Realm, a character who actually didn’t exist in the game’s story.

Granted two mysterious powers, “Protagonist Setting Adjustment” and “Power of Conquest,” Joo In-gong now must alter the game’s plot to survive against Zephyr.

Yet, with every twist of the plot, he garners more attention…
description.ko:
''주인공'은 즐겨하던 게임의 리메이크판인 <나이트 사가:re>를 플레이하던 중,
게임 속으로 끌려들어 간다.

그런데 무언가 이상하다.
<나이트 사가:re>에서 플레이어블 캐릭터는 인간 편의 로크, 마계 편의 제피르뿐.
그러나 정신을 차려보니 '인공'이 빙의한 것은
존재감 없는 마계의 9왕자 슈트라였다.

영문을 알 수 없는 상황 속에서 '인공'에게 주어진 것은
'주인공 보정'과 '정복의 힘'이라는 미지의 능력.

마계 편의 주인공인 제피르에게서 살아남기 위해
'인공'은 슈트라로서 게임의 전개를 바꿔나간다.

그리고 게임이 바뀌면 바뀔수록
무능했던 9왕자 슈트라에게 모두가 주목하게 되는데...

description.en: Novice gamer Youngsik Yuu, who finds himself sucked into a game world several years in the past, attempts to make the most of his wealth of knowledge, to survive in a world unwittingly bracing for a huge war.
description.ko: 게임 속으로 빨려들어간 초보 게이머 유영식은 거대한 전쟁이 예약된 그 세계에서 살아남기 위해 자신의 이점을 최대한 활용하기로 한다. 그 이점이란 플레이어로서의 특권과 이미 숙지하고 있던 게임에 대한 방대한 지식이었다!

description.en:
He is recognized as the strongest existence, standing at the top of the world.  
  
Wealth? Fame? Power? It was not worth mentioning in his eyes.  
  
The strongest apostles fled and startled the human continent for the reason: "Don’t get me wrong! Lao Zi came to look for his future wife!"  
  
Yes, it’s a story about the strongest single apostle ever looking for a wife.

Our hero, Mo Fan, inherits a magical necklace—the next day, he wakes up to find that the world has changed. His high school now teaches magic, and students are encouraged to try and become accomplished magicians. A world that ran on science now runs on magic. However, some things are still the same. He still has a teacher who sees him as a hopeless student, classmates who look the same, a father who struggles to make ends meet, and a not-by-blood little sister who can't walk on her own.
However, Mo Fan discovers that the vast majority of magicians can only harness one element of magic. As luck would have it, however, he is an exception—a versatile mage!

(Source: WebNovel)

description.it:
Si sveglia e il mondo cambia. La vecchia scuola ora insegna la magia, incoraggiando i suoi studenti a diventare i più grandi maghi che possono essere. Oltre i confini della città, le bestie magiche vagano a caccia di esseri umani.  
  
Il mondo scientifico è diventato un mondo magico. Ma alcune cose non sono cambiate, lo stesso insegnante che lo guarda dall'alto in basso, gli stessi studenti che lo disprezzano, lo stesso padre che lavora sodo per mantenerli, e la stessa sorellastra che non può camminare.  
  
Anche così, Mo Fan ha scoperto che mentre il resto della gente può usare un singolo elemento, lui può usare tutta la magia!
description.pl:
Gdy się obudził, świat nie wyglądał już tak samo. Znajome mu liceum uczy teraz magii, zachęcając uczniów do zostania jak najwspanialszymi magami. Poza granicami miasta zaś wędrują magiczne bestie żerujące na ludziach.  
  
Świat zaawansowanej nauki zamienił się w świat zaawansowanej magii. Nie zmienili się za to nauczyciel i uczniowie, którzy nadal patrzą na niego z lekceważeniem. Tacy sami pozostali też jego ojciec, zmagający się z trudnościami na dnie drabiny społeczeństwa, ani niewinna przyrodnia siostra, która nie może chodzić.   
  
Jednak Mo Fan odkrywa, że mimo iż wszyscy inni mogą używać tylko jednego głównego żywiołu, on sam może używać wszystkich rodzajów magii!!
description.pt-br:
Ele acorda e o mundo mudou. A antiga escola agora ensina magia, encorajando seus estudantes a se tornarem os maiores magos que eles podem ser. Além dos limites da cidade, bestas magicas perambulam caçando humanos.  
  
O mundo cientifico agora se transformou em um mundo magico. Mas ainda, algumas coisas não mudaram, o mesmo professor que olha com desdem para ele, os mesmos estudantes que desprezam ele, o mesmo pai que trabalha muito para sustenta-los, e a mesma meia-irmã que não consegue andar.  
  
Mesmo assim, Mo Fan descobriu que enquanto o resto das pessoas pode usar um único elemento, ele pode usar toda a magia!!

description.de:
Nachdem sie in einen Roman gezogen wurde, lebt Leann ein einfaches Leben als Priesterin, die Leute heilt, die sich in roten Fäden verfangen haben. Der rote Faden ist ein Zeichen des Todes, das langsam den Körper zerstört und einen so schrittweise dem Tod näherbringt. Außer der Protagonistin des Romans ist Leann die Einzige, die diese roten Fäden sehen und entfernen kann. Als sie jedoch einen jungen Mann heilt, der verletzt auf der Straße liegt, verbindet der rote Faden des Schicksals die beiden und lässt sich nicht mehr entfernen! Zu allem Unglück ist die Person, mit der Leann nun verbunden ist, auch noch Abell, der schlimmste Bösewicht des Romans! Kann sie es schaffen, sich von ihm zu lösen und ein friedliches Leben zu leben, ohne den ursprünglichen Verlauf der Geschichte zu beeinflussen?

description.fr:
Lorsqu'elle se réveille subitement dans un roman, Leann décide de mener une vie sans remous de prêtresse dans un temple où elle soigne ceux qui sont entremêlés dans les fils rouges. Ces fils rouges sont le signe d'un grave danger puisqu'ils détruisent peu à peu le corps de celui qui s'y trouve emmêlé jusqu'à finir par causer sa mort; or à part l'héroïne du roman, Leann semble être la seule à pouvoir les voir et les retirer. Mais un beau jour, alors qu'elle essaie de soigner un homme croisé au hasard dans la rue, un fil rouge du destin se forme entre lui et elle et les unit d'un lien que nul ne peut défaire. Et comme si ce n'était pas déjà un assez gros problème, il s'avère que la personne à laquelle Leann est liée, n'est autre qu'Abell, le personnage le plus horrible de l'histoire! Réussira-t-elle à lui échapper et à mener une vie calme et paisible sans changer le cours de l'histoire?

description.en:
I "transmigrated" into a world I'd never seen before.

For 30 years, I believed I was living in a classic fantasy RPG.
I became a war hero, retired, and thought I was finally about to see the ending.
But...

Those 30 years were only the prologue.
It turns out the real story is about an academy?
description.ko:
처음 보는 세계에 ‘빙의’했다. 
왕도 RPG라고 생각하고 30년을 보냈다. 
전쟁영웅이 되어 퇴역했고, 이제 엔딩을 맞이할 예정이었다. 

그런데ㅡ 
지금까지의 30년이 프롤로그였고, 심지어 아카데미물이었다고?
description.ru: Я оказался внутри незнакомой игры. Решив, что это классическая RPG, я прожил в ней тридцать лет, стал героем войны, вышел в отставку и собирался спокойно провести оставшееся время. Но что? Всё это время это была история про академию?

description.en:
"Add more firewood if you don't want to turn into ashes". 
In time of desperation he have flames that can kill demons. However the flames make its master a demon who desires ashes.
description.ko:
'장작을 넣어라, 잿더미가 되고 싶지 않다면'
 
절체절명의 순간, 악마를 죽일 수 있는 불꽃을 손에 넣었다.
하지만 그 불꽃은 주인을 재를 탐하는 악마로 만드는데...
description.ru: Рыцарь, сохраняющий свою повседневную жизнь, и демон, который уничтожает все на своем пути.
description.pt-br:
A única esperança contra os demônios são os cavaleiros do milagre. Magpie foi agraciado com o poder supremo: a chama que aniquila demônios. Contudo, o preço é terrível — o fogo o corrompe, transformando-o na própria criatura que ele caça, com uma sede insaciável por cinzas.
Para manter sua humanidade (e a vida dos outros), ele tem um aviso simples:
“Alimente o fogo com lenha, a menos que queira se tornar a próxima pilha de cinzas.”

altTitles.en: I Made a Contract With Myself

description.en: This is a world where awakened people and alienated beasts coexist. Zhang Ping was lucky to become an awakened person, but his ability was rated as useless. He was unwilling to live a mediocre life, so he resolutely swallowed the contract gem that ordinary people avoided like snakes and scorpions, contracted himself, and became his own summoned beast! From then on, the whole world opened up to him. Ever-changing superpowers, endless alienated beasts, and dangerous parallel worlds, everything is possible.

The power of Valhalla's warriors is called Saga. It is the mighty, magical power born from their achievements and deeds in their former lives. Thus, the more stories and legends of these warriors spread and linger in the hearts of many, the stronger their Saga becomes.

Tae Ho himself was certainly no warrior. However, he was the world's top professional gamer. In the game world of Dark Age, his character, Dragon Knight Kalsted could rightly be called a legend in his own right.

His achievements, his story.

All the accomplishments that the Dragon Knight Kalsted had accumulated in the game!
[Saga: Immortal Warrior] The story of the immortal warrior, Lee Tae Ho, unfolds on the battlefield of the gods, Valhalla. To put an end to Ragnarok, which threatens the world's very existence, a new Saga begins at this very moment.
description.ko:
발할라 전사들의 힘은 사가. 그것은 현생의 위업과 업적을 기반으로 탄생시킨 위대한 마법의 힘.
그렇기에 이야기와 전승이 널리 퍼지면 퍼질수록, 많은 이들의 마음에 남으면 남을수록 사가의 힘은 강해진다.
태호 자신은 분명 전사가 아니었다. 하지만 세계 최고의 프로게이머였다.
다크 에이지의 세계에서 용기사 칼스테드는 전설 그 자체라 해도 좋았다.

그의 위업, 그의 이야기.

용기사 칼스테드가 게임 속에서 쌓아올린 모든 업적들!
[사가 : 불멸의 전사] 신들의 전장 발할라.그곳에서 펼쳐지는 불멸의 전사 이태호의 이야기.
세계의 멸망을 초래할 라그나로크를 끝내기 위해, 지금 이 순간 새로운 사가가 시작된다.

description.en:
In the game Aether World, **Baek Yuseol** is considered the most useless character because he can't use magic like everyone else. His only skill, Blink, is a short-range teleportation ability most players consider worthless. But when he’s tasked with reaching the game's true ending, Baek Yuseol decides to use his unconventional skill to achieve this impossible goal. 

Can this so-called "**TRASH**" character outsmart his powerful peers, form unlikely alliances, and ultimately master the game?
description.pt-br: O personagem com maior dificuldade e pior desempenho, Baek Yuseol, foi considerado um personagem lixo no jogo porque não conseguia usar magia em um cenário de fantasia onde todos os outros podiam. No entanto… [Como o final errado foi alcançado, 90% do Mundo Éter foi destruído.] [Por favor, alcance o “Final Verdadeiro”.] De repente, essas palavras ecoaram em minha mente antes de eu ser transmigrado para o Mundo Éter. [Você pode usar a habilidade “Teletransporte”.] “Por que eu possuí esse personagem?” Teletransporte era a única habilidade mágica que eu tinha. Sobrevivendo na Academia Stella entre magos geniais, me tornei o notório Mago do Teletransporte.

altTitles.pt-br: Invocado Demais, Forte Demais e de Saco Cheio!

description.en:
It was another boring school day, or so thought Inori Takafuji until Goddess summons him and his classmates to a different world. 

Just as Inori gets excited for a new life, he is banished and resummoned to other worlds over and over again, each time with new, additional powers! 

Will there be an actual challenge and suspense befitting our super-packed hero or will the adventure be a breeze?
description.ko:
고등학생 타카후지 이노리는 반 친구들과 함께 다른 세계로 소환되고 만다.
새로운 생활을 기대하던 찰나, 발밑에 다시 마법진이 출현해 무작정 다른 세계로 소환되어 버린다!
거듭된 소환 끝에 이노리의 수중에 남은 것은 주인공급의 수많은 사기 능력인데…

description.en: One day, I woke up as a noble inside the game I used to play. Unfortunately, the game ends in an apocalypse. With ten years left, I track down the future villains while they’re still kids and decide to raise them myself, hoping that a better childhood could stop them from destroying the world. Now, with criminals dropping like flies, the kingdom thinks I’m the terrifying mastermind pulling all the strings. What on earth is happening? I just wanted to enjoy the sweet noble life!
description.fr: Un jeune actif passionné de RPG se retrouve transposé dans le corps d'un antagoniste secondaire du jeu Psychedelia. Seulement voilà, sa nouvelle vie de noble provilégié est menacée par l'arrivée des 5 péchés capitaux, prêts à détruire le monde dans 10 ans. Pour éviter cela, il les prend sous son aile avant qu'ils ne soient irrécupérables et devient leur bienfaiteur. Cependant, la situation va vite prendre un tournant très inattendu...
description.id: Alon Palatio adalah seorang budak korporat yang masuk ke dalam dunia game bernama Psychedelia sebagai seorang bangsawan. Meski bergelar bangsawan, dia hanyalah karakter figuran yang ditakdirkan mati di tangan kelompok villain bernama 5 Dosa Besar. Demi bertahan hidup dan menikmati kehidupan bangsawan, dia memutuskan untuk mencegah para calon penjahat itu jatuh ke jalan kegelapan dengan menjadi sponsor mereka saat mereka masih kecil.
description.ko: 좋소 노예인 내가 게임 속 귀족으로 빙의되었다. 근데 미래의 악당들에게 죽는 엑스트라라고? 이들을 교화시켜 어떻게든 귀족 생활을 누리고 말 테다! 아직 어린 악당들의 흑화를 막기 위해 후원했고, 어려운 환경을 극복하게 만들어줬다. 그 결과 뿌듯함이 느껴질 만큼 모두 훌륭하고 평범하게 자랐다. 그렇게 나는 왕국의 최종 흑막이 되었다. …예?
description.ru:
Я, бывший раб корпорации, перевоплотился в дворянина в игре.
Но говорят, я всего лишь статист, который умрёт от рук будущих злодеев? Я должен перевоспитать их и во что бы то ни стало насладиться дворянской жизнью!

Так я стал покровителем ещё юных злодеев, чтобы предотвратить их падение в тьму, и помог им преодолеть тяжёлые времена.
В итоге благодаря мне все они выросли замечательными и обычными людьми.

И я стал главным закулисным злодеем королевства.
– Чего...?
description.th: ฉัน มนุษย์เงินเดือนที่ถวายชีวิตให้กับบริษัท อยู่ดี ๆ กลับตื่นขึ้นมาในร่างของขุนนางภายในเกมเสียอย่างงั้น!? แถมตัวละครที่ฉันสิงอยู่ยังเป็นแค่ตัวประกอบที่ถูกลิขิตให้ตายด้วยน้ำมือของเหล่าตัวร้ายในอนาคตอีกต่างหาก! ไม่มีทางหรอก! ฉันจะทำให้พวกเด็กเกเรพวกนั้นกลับตัว แล้วใช้ชีวิตขุนนางอย่างสงบสุขให้ได้! เพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้เหล่าตัวร้ายวัยเด็กกลายเป็นปีศาจ ฉันจึงอุปการะพวกเขา ช่วยให้พวกเขาผ่านพ้นชีวิตอันโหดร้าย จนพวกเขาทั้งหมดเติบโตขึ้นเป็นคนดี มีคุณธรรม และดู "ปกติ" อย่างสมบูรณ์แบบ และด้วยเหตุนี้เอง…ฉันถึงได้กลายเป็น บอสคนสุดท้ายของอาณาจักร!? ...เดี๋ยวสิ อะไรนะ!?
description.zh:
一不小心养成了世界级误会
只想活着怎么就成大BOSS了
想在游戏世界里当个安稳贵族，却发现自己竟是注定被未来反派杀掉的路人角色。为了活下去，他提前出手扶养、资助、引导那些还未堕落的危险人物。本以为成功改变命运，却在不知不觉中，被整个王国视作操纵一切的幕后黑手。明明什么都没做坏事，为什么结局会变成这样？
description.zh-hk: 曾為社畜的我穿越成為了遊戲中的貴族角色，雖然偏偏是個未來將被反派殺害的支線路人，但是沒關係！就讓我用金錢的力量，好好教化這群還是小小孩的反派角色，並享受成為貴族的優渥待遇吧！ 皇天不負苦心人，在認真的栽培之下，他們全都成長為平凡的大人，然而我…卻成了王國中的最終BOSS?!

description.en:
Hyeonseok Choi finally becomes the undisputed heavyweight MMA champion of the world, but gets hit by a truck, and dies. 

A fairy, Rahel, appears and convinces him to fight as a hero in the afterlife, but accidentally sends him to the side of the demons. 

Stuck in the demon world, he sweet talks his way into positions of power, but slowly discovers this battle between good and evil isn't as clearcut as it seems.
description.ko:
세상에서 가장 강한 남자라 불렸던 사나이.세계 최대 격투기 리그의 헤비급 챔피언.최강의 남자였던 최현석은 죽음 이후 이세계의 용사로서 새로운 삶을 시작한다.

'부! 명예! 미녀를 독차지하는 용사!'

찬란한 미래를 꿈꾸며 이세계로 이동한 그가 조우한 것은 자신보다 머리 하나는 더 큰 근육질의 소대가리를 괴물.마왕군의 간부였던 괴물이 물었다.

"용사? 네가 용사라는 거냐?"
“어... 용사일걸요...?”

그렇게 지옥이 시작됐다.

Chew the Academy With a Sashimi Stick

description.en:
Chef Kim, Korea's legendary sashimi master, is transported into the world of Blessing M, a mobile game he once played. But instead of being a hero, he finds himself as Geomma Kang, a mere background extra. 

Forced into a new life, Geomma discovers a new power: the Blessing of the Blade God. Now, to survive in this game-like world, he must slice through challenges and enemies alike. 

Will his unmatched skills in the kitchen be enough to carve out a new destiny?
description.pt-br:
Se eu cortar, será rompido.”

Eu, que já fui chamado de o melhor espadachim da nação, caí em um jogo de celular no qual gastei apenas um pouco de dinheiro.

Além disso, fui agraciado com a “Bênção do Deus da Espada”…!

description.en: Derek lives by one creed. Fight, adapt, and rely only on himself. In the years after the System arrived on Earth and warped it into a monster-ridden wasteland, those rules forged him into one of Earth’s most powerful warriors. They let him thrive in the face of the Apocalypse — until the day he broke them. Failed by his teammates and sent through the void into an entirely new world, fate seems to have wanted Derek to start all the way back from the beginning at level 1. It’s a good thing he brought his old System with him.

description.en: Ron accidentally travels to another world, but before he can even enjoy the thrill of his journey, he's framed and guillotined. On his deathbed, the system sends a cheat to avert the crisis. He also picks up a super cute and clingy witch along the way. A beautiful duchess from the empire suddenly appears, offering her territory, and a tsundere dragon maid takes care of her. Guided by the system, Ron is about to embark on a joyful journey into another world. But no one ever tells him that the same system has killed all ninety-nine other travelers before him! Whose conspiracy is all this?
description.zh: 罗恩作为第一百个穿越者来到了异世界，并且喜闻乐见地得到了系统。 可是从来没有人告诉过他前面九十九个穿越者都被这个系统逼死了！！！ 在被系统逼到站在诸神对立面之际，他曾经救下的女巫们成为他的拥趸，拥立他为王。 “纵使世界的真理之环已经破碎，也请你成为王。”女巫们高呼道。 ...

description.en:
The protagonist, who was enjoying the RPG game Dragon Slayer Academy, succeeds in raising 1,000 S-class heroes as the strongest supporter in the game.

One day, a mysterious quest window appears in front of him, and he is presented with a hidden quest that allows him to raise EX-class heroes that surpass S-class heroes.

Upon accepting the quest, he finds himself transported into the game world of Dragon Slayer Academy...
description.ko:
RPG 게임 '용살학원'을 즐기던 주인공, 게임 내 최강 서포터로서 무려 1,000명의 S급 영웅을 육성하는 데 성공한다.

그러던 어느 날, 눈앞에 의문의 퀘스트 창이 등장하고, S급을 뛰어넘는 EX급 영웅을 키울 수 있는 히든 퀘스트가 제시된다.

퀘스트를 수락한 순간, 그는 게임 속 세계 ‘용살학원’으로빙의하게 되는데…

description.en:
When his total scumbags of parents die, he finds himself with a mysterious inheritance of 500 million yen.

Deciding to do whatever he likes from then on, the boy enters the most challenging online game, “Dungeon Attack,” where he becomes the first to unlock the achievement of defeating all the Demon Lords. However, when he answers a mysterious question that appears after completing the game, he suddenly finds himself sent into the game world.

He had been reincarnated as “Dantalian,” the lowest and weakest Demon Lord, ranked 71st in the game world! With nothing but his memory of defeating the strongest Demon Lord and his eloquence to rely on, he fights to survive in this brutal world – this is a story of comeback and revenge!

description.en: Pursuing your master in seven different worlds to revive her in the original world! Every world with different identities and personalities, follow Hua Yingying on her journey to make all the seven different versions of her master, Bai Hansu, fall for her while also slipping through the schemes of her old master from the demon sect!
description.zh: 花樱樱一朝穿成小孤女，命悬一线之时，天降仙女师尊，救她于水火。 于是花樱樱日日撩夜夜追，终于舔化冰山，只等师尊渡劫成功就能双宿双修，双宿双飞…… 谁成想师尊居然渡劫失败，碎成了渣渣！ 为了复活师尊，花樱樱穿梭七重镜界，要和七个不同身份的切片师尊酱酱酿酿，水乳交融！ 花樱樱捏拳，无奈道：开后宫什么的，都是为了拯救师尊呐！

description.en:
Listen up folks! I’m living my life with the Demon Queen!  
  
A normal powerless male protagonist is entrusted to look after the fallen Demon Queen Isabella. Depleted of her powers, Isabella is forced to camouflage as a human and suppress her regal status. Evil masterminds plot to dethrone the powerful Demon Queen in a medieval fantasy land.
description.ru: Сян Е был довольно обычным молодым человеком, но после того, как он купил кольцо, он оказывается вызванным в другой мир членами Племени Демонов, включая их королеву Изабеллу Осу. Пытаясь спасти их жизни от армий людей, Сян Е говорит, что теперь сильно ослабленная Изабелла — его жена И Бей. Теперь оба должны попытаться стать сильнее, чтобы выжить на территории столицы человеческой империи.

title.en: The Strongest Magical Swordsman Ever Reborn as an F-Rank Adventurer

altTitles.ja: 史上最強の魔法剣士、Fランク冒険者に転生する タテマンガ版

altTitles.ja-ro: Shijou Saikyou no Mahou Kenshi, F Rank Boukensha ni Tensei Suru

description.en:
Yuri was the hero who saved the world, being called “Demon Emperor” in his first reincarnation and “Sword Saint” in his second reincarnation. However, before he knew it, he was considered a “monster” and was shunned by people. Yuri finally gets fed up and decides to live 100% for himself next time.

He reincarnates into the future and is immediately attacked by monsters. As he defends himself, Yuri acquires the skills of his previous lives and quickly annihilates his enemies. Eventually, Yuri arrives at the adventurers guild and decides to start his life as an F-rank novice adventurer while hiding his true strength.

A different world fantasy of a man who has mastered both magic and swordsmanship begins!!

“The Change” brought dungeons filled with monsters into the world, altering reality forever. Pro-gamer Jin Jungdo, whose lifelong dream was to be a hero like the Mana Users who fight in these dungeons, is crushed when he discovers his own abilities are useless. Just then, the “real universe” gives him a set of skills that allow him to draw information from the future and heroes from the past! Now all that’s left is for him to barrel through this game of luck and become the strongest hunter ever!
description.fr: Le pire jour de ma vie, j’ai reçu un miracle comme cadeau de la part du  »véritable univers ».
description.ko: 전 재산을 쏟아부어 헌터로 각성했는데… 전투형 스킬 하나 없는 소통, 인내, 게임 탤런트뿐이라고? 헌터 사무소 영업직 인생은 이제 그만 살고 싶다고...! 간절히 바라면 이루어지는가! 인생 최악의 날, 우주로부터 최강의 스킬을 얻었다! 클래스를 뒤집는 운빨 갓겜이 시작된다. <뽑기로 강해진 SSS급 헌터>
description.ru: В один из худших дней в моей жизни, на меня снизошло чудо в виде подарка от "вселенной".

One day, Eden falls from the sky. All he remembers is his name and that if he doesn't find the treasure and defeat the 
Demon King within 90 days, he will cease to exist.
With his best friend Coupie, they work together to suppress magic and prevent Eden from disappearing!

description.en: Kasia del Roman is a soldier crafted to become an assassin. She lost her human emotions long ago and lived her life as a simple tool, just to be thrown away in her final moments. She couldn’t even die a proper death as she opened her eyes to a battlefield of a different world. Will she live the same life she did in her original world?
description.es:
Kasia del Romas es un soldado entrenado para ser un asesino. Ella perdió sus emociones humanas hace mucho tiempo y vivió su vida como una simple herramienta, solo para ser abandonada en sus últimos momentos.

Ni siquiera fue capaz de tener una muerte apropiada, ya que abrió los ojos a un campo de batalla de un mundo diferente. ¿Vivirá la misma vida que vivió en su mundo original?

description.en:
Karna was a boy that was given the title of “Wise man” from heaven, is scouted by the hero party that had great expectations for his skills. However, his job of “necromancer” was creepy and he was immediately exiled.

Karna, who got lost on the road without getting a reward, had accidentally invaded the Demon Lord’s territory and was targeted by the demons! Karna faced a demon with a mighty power, but defeats it with magic that overwhemed it by far. A fearsome demon. Meanwhile, Cecilia the demon, who saw the whole scene, offers Karna a large annual salary. And Karna decided to become an enemy of humanity as a magician with the Demon King army.

altTitles.ja: レベル999黒幕公女になりました

I Became the Level 999 Demon King
I Became a Level 999 Mastermind Demon King

description.en: The terminally ill daughter of a poor family is given a new lease on life when she is granted the chance to be reborn as anyone she wants. But her plans go awry when she accidentally wishes to become the wrong character of the video game she likes—Raina Rubellite, the final evil boss that torments the righteous main character of the game “The Power of Love”. Now, our protagonist finds herself reborn as an evil devil queen with overpowered dark magic powers, but she won’t let the video game’s plot stop her from living the life of her dreams!
description.ko:
게임에 빙의했다.
그것도 주인공이 아닌 마왕(Lv.999)으로.
마왕으로 태어났다는 이유만으로 가문에서 10년 동안 유폐당한 것은 물론,
심지어 광활한 눈벌판이 전부인 북부로 쫓겨나기까지 했다.
그런데 마법으로 온실을 만들 수 있다면?
농사나 지으며 은퇴한 중년의 삶을 살아가려 하지만,
남주 후보들이 멋대로 쳐들어와 내 집 마련 계획을 방해하고 난리다.

altTitles.en: To Another World on my Own!
Go to A Different World On Your Own!
Going to Another World on Your Own!

altTitles.ja: 自力で異世界へ！ ～優しい仲間と一緒に異世界生活を満喫します～

description.en: Tarou Satu, a young man who longed for an otherworldly adventure since a child and devoted his youth to finding it, finally goes to another world on his own. However, things did not go well for him, as his previous life’s memories were about to be erased by God. Despite that, he almost dies during his reincarnation process, which allows him to fulfil the condition for a special ability and luckily, keep his old memories. From there, the now reincarnated Tauro Satu, grows up by using his brains and efforts while gradually developing his mysterious skill, Garbled Text, which everyone thought to be completely useless.

altTitles.en: My Daughter Is the Demon King When I Was Reincarnated

description.en: Ji-hyeok, a public defender, was living a hard life looking at his daughter, who was not worth it. Ji-hyeok, who lost his life along with his daughter in a car accident, asks God. “Because I don’t need it!! I just need to see my daughter again!!” After such a persistent request, he arrives in a new world with the power of observation and persuasion, and Ji-hyeok finds out that he is the devil’s butler and lawyer. And he finally comes face to face with the Demon King…. “So Eun-ah…” Surprisingly, the Demon King was in the form of his daughter. The Demon King’s Castle, which was destroyed by the luxury and pleasure of the previous Demon King! Attack of the warriors! The protests of monsters are pouring in every day! Only Ji-hyeok can protect her daughter!

altTitles.zh: 猎能者（猎能者·猎能学院）

description.en: Gu Xinghe is a high school student with few words. After a mysterious bloody red rain, he suddenly found he became the target of a group of monstrous creatures, "the Death Disciples." Whatsmore, his beloved friend Lu Yang fell into a coma on his birthday from the monsters' attack, while Xinghe was saved by a girl with tremendous power. To save his friend, Xinghe joined the "Energy Hunters" academy that the girl attends, and start training to fight the "Death Disciples" and other dark powers.
description.pt: Gu Xinghe é um estudante do ensino médio de poucas palavras. Depois de uma misteriosa chuva vermelha sangrenta, ele descobriu que se tornou o alvo de um grupo de criaturas monstruosas, “os discípulos da morte”. Além disso, sua melhor amiga Lu Yang entrou em coma em seu aniversário durante o ataque do monstro, enquanto Xinghe foi resgatado por uma garota com um tremendo poder. Para salvar sua amiga, Xinghe se junta à Academia dos “caçadores de energia” e começa a treinar para combater os “discípulos da morte” e outros poderes obscuros.

Zuo Yi, a transmigrator, fought and struggled in the world of Sadya for three hundred years. During his fight with the Abyssal Lord, Saur, he was sent back to the blue planet.

To his immense shock, he had somehow gained an adorable four-year-old daughter! Zuo Yi, who has long been tired of the life of a knight, gradually interacts with the blue planet's various forces and ultimately resolves the global crisis—all for the sake of building an ideal world for his precious child.

The witch’s descent, David Sun, has decided to join the modern society after learning all the witchery and vermin from his master. He doesn’t have any goals other than his family’s well-being and earn some extra money by saving people from illness. He did not expect trouble to come to find him. While facing all the temptation and evil, watch how a fatty hides from others’ sight and promotes witchery…

In the Larteard Mountains, a huge mountainous region occupying the center of the continent, lived the Red Dragon Clan, the dirtiest of dragons…  
  
A 300-year old child (?), who yearned for the adventure of the human warrior, turned into a human being using the only form-conversion magic, "Polymorph," to secretly run away from home.

description.en:
On his way towards the hospital, our protagonist Yang Ni was mugged and killed by someone who despised him. When he woke up, he had arrived in a place in between life and death called "Huang Quan." He learnt that by playing the games in Huang Quan, he could receive a chance to be resurrected and return back to the land of the living. Buckle up for a thrilling adventure with Yang Ni and the friends he makes along the way.  


---
description.es: En su camino hacia el hospital, Yang Ni fue asesinado. Cuando se despertó había llegado al Inframundo un lugar lleno de demonios y criaturas mágicas. Él se entero que era posible volver al mundo de los vivos jugando al juego de la "Vida", ahora él se embarcara en una aventura para ser resucitado.

description.en: The time when the immortal emperor Xia Guixuan and his nemesis were both wounded, the emperor retreated to the core of a remote planet in the universe to heal his wounds. The planet’s environment was gradually transformed by the spiritual energy emanating from him, and transformed into a liveable planet with abundant spiritual aura. The original creature that lived in this remote planet began to evolve into human beings to cultivate and develop their own civilisation. A few years later, human exploration spacecraft from the Milky Way discovered this new civilisation. Throughout the universe, unknown yet powerful beings began to target this planet. Many parties collided, and heroes rose together.
description.zh: 修仙觅长生，热血任逍遥，踏莲曳波涤剑骨，凭虚御风塑圣魂！多宇宙文明的碰撞主题，加少量的游戏都市时间。

description.en: Li Chang An, the main protagonist of the show has been sent back into an Ancient World by a booklet with a yellow cover. Here, in this world, with each demon he kills, he would obtain a supernatural power. After he had executed hundreds of thousands of demons, drawn out his sword and looked around him, only then did he just come to the realization that all that he had known, and went through, was just the beginning of a long and drawn – out suffering in this unending hell of demons and death alike.

A post apocalyptic world without an ability to use fire.  
But there is a single woman who can cast fire and she is wanted.
